Discover Premium Wholesale Wheat Grass Powder

Welcome to Tradenest Naturals. We manufacture premium wholesale wheat grass powder for global food, beverage, and nutraceutical brands. Our state-of-the-art facility uses advanced dehydration techniques. Therefore, we lock in vital nutrients, vibrant green color, and natural freshness. As a trusted wheat grass powder supplier, we help businesses scale with reliable, high-purity ingredients. We carefully harvest young wheatgrass shoots at their peak nutritional value. Next, we wash, sanitize, and gently process the leaves. This ensures maximum retention of chlorophyll, vitamins, and minerals. In fact, our advanced production lines make us a preferred choice among wheat grass powder manufacturers worldwide. Partner with us today for consistent, premium-grade supplies.

Superior Manufacturing and Quality Standards

Quality remains our top priority at Tradenest Naturals. Our manufacturing plant adheres to strict food safety management systems. We test every batch for microbial purity, heavy metals, and moisture content. As a leading wheat grass powder exporter India, we guarantee compliance with international food safety regulations. Our spray-dried and air-dried milling processes yield an ultra-fine particle size. This ensures excellent solubility in water, juices, and shakes. Moreover, our strict batch traceability systems guarantee full transparency from farm to final export. You can trust our products for your most demanding formulations.

Key Manufacturing Highlights:

  • Direct sourcing from trusted agricultural networks
  • Hygienic washing and low-temperature drying
  • Advanced pulverizing for ultra-fine mesh sizes
  • Rigorous in-house and third-party laboratory testing

Flexible Commercial Terms and Bulk Supply

Are you wondering about our pricing and order terms? We offer competitive bulk wheat grass powder price structures tailored for global distributors and FMCG brands. Our flexible Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) accommodates both growing enterprises and large-scale industrial buyers. You can easily request a custom quote or sample through our sales desk. We also provide private label (OEM) services. Whether you need custom retail pouches or export-ready drums, we deliver. Our team ensures fast lead times and dependable global shipping. Contact our export desk today to discuss your specific volume requirements.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for wholesale wheat grass powder?

Our MOQ is flexible based on your packaging needs. Standard bulk orders start at 25 kg, while custom private label runs have separate thresholds. Contact us for a tailored quote.

What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, purity)?

Our standard powder features an 80-100 mesh size, less than 5% moisture content, and 100% pure green wheatgrass with no added fillers or artificial colors.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We pack our products in food-grade foil pouches, HDPE containers, and export drums. When stored in cool, dry conditions, the shelf life is up to 24 months.

How do I request a sample or place a trial order?

You can submit a direct quote request through our website. Our sales team will respond within 24 hours with sample availability and freight estimates.

  • FSSAI — Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
